description: Read one public Hourkeeper decision by decision_id, returning its public evidence/rule summary, confidence and available review/reversal details. Obtain the ID from get_hourkeeper_history or a public reference. No authentication required; private evidence and hidden prompts are excluded. Unknown IDs return an unknown/uncertain result; use challenge_hourkeeper_decision to request review.

decision_id.description: Required public Hourkeeper decision UUID from get_hourkeeper_history or a public decision link.
